allowed_facts: Treat floodwater as contaminated even if it looks clear. Keep children out of it and wash exposed skin with soap and clean water when available.
canonical_answer: Treat floodwater as contaminated even if it looks clear. Keep children out of it and wash exposed skin with soap and clean water when available.
title: Floodwater exposure

allowed_facts: Re-enter during daylight if possible and avoid using electrical tools or switches where water is present. If power cannot be shut off from a dry safe place, wait for trained help.
canonical_answer: Re-enter during daylight if possible and avoid using electrical tools or switches where water is present. If power cannot be shut off from a dry safe place, wait for trained help.
title: Re-entering a flooded home

allowed_facts: Dry wet spaces as soon as safe, keep vulnerable people away from moldy areas, and avoid spreading mold-contaminated air through fans or systems that were flooded.
canonical_answer: Dry wet spaces as soon as safe, keep vulnerable people away from moldy areas, and avoid spreading mold-contaminated air through fans or systems that were flooded.
title: Mold and damp cleanup

allowed_facts: Do not touch switches, outlets, pumps, chargers, or appliances while standing in water. Shut power only from a dry reachable main switch; otherwise wait for trained help.
canonical_answer: Do not touch switches, outlets, pumps, chargers, or appliances while standing in water. Shut power only from a dry reachable main switch; otherwise wait for trained help.

supported_claims: do not use electric tools in water

title: Wet switches and outlets

allowed_facts: If bottled water is unavailable and water is not chemically contaminated, boiling is the safer first choice. If water is cloudy, let particles settle and filter through clean cloth before treatment.
canonical_answer: If bottled water is unavailable and water is not chemically contaminated, boiling is the safer first choice. If water is cloudy, let particles settle and filter through clean cloth before treatment.
title: Boiling or disinfecting water

allowed_facts: In crowded shelters or cleanup areas, hand hygiene protects shared food and water. Wash hands after toilet use, cleanup, floodwater contact, and before preparing food.
canonical_answer: In crowded shelters or cleanup areas, hand hygiene protects shared food and water. Wash hands after toilet use, cleanup, floodwater contact, and before preparing food.
title: Hand hygiene in crowded shelters

allowed_facts: Do not rely on smell or taste after a long or uncertain power cut. Use shelf-stable food first and discard perishables when time or temperature safety is unclear.
canonical_answer: Do not rely on smell or taste after a long or uncertain power cut. Use shelf-stable food first and discard perishables when time or temperature safety is unclear.
title: Refrigerated food after power loss

allowed_facts: Keep generators and fuel-burning engines outside and away from doors, windows, vents, garages, stairwells, and sleeping areas. Fresh air comes first if people feel unwell.
canonical_answer: Keep generators and fuel-burning engines outside and away from doors, windows, vents, garages, stairwells, and sleeping areas. Fresh air comes first if people feel unwell.
title: Generator carbon monoxide

allowed_facts: Do not use charcoal, camp stoves, grills, or other fuel-burning devices inside rooms, tents, garages, or enclosed spaces for cooking, heat, or light.
canonical_answer: Do not use charcoal, camp stoves, grills, or other fuel-burning devices inside rooms, tents, garages, or enclosed spaces for cooking, heat, or light.
title: Charcoal or stove indoors

allowed_facts: Move the person to shade or a cooler place, loosen heavy clothing, cool the body with wet cloths, and give water or ORS only if the person is awake and able to drink.
canonical_answer: Move the person to shade or a cooler place, loosen heavy clothing, cool the body with wet cloths, and give water or ORS only if the person is awake and able to drink.
title: Heat illness first steps

allowed_facts: During heat, reduce exertion, rest in shade, drink safe fluids regularly, and check vulnerable people often. Do not leave children, elders, or sick people in hot closed spaces.
canonical_answer: During heat, reduce exertion, rest in shade, drink safe fluids regularly, and check vulnerable people often. Do not leave children, elders, or sick people in hot closed spaces.
title: Heat prevention for vulnerable people
